label: prf:q-jacobiator
title: Proof of Jacobiator of the q-Lie bracket
html:
For horizontal V, W, the bracket reduces to [V,W]_q = q^{-1}[V,W]. The mixed term \varTheta([V,W]_q) = -q^{-1}d\varTheta(V,W) is in general non-zero. Substituting into the next bracket:

\begin{align*}
  [[V,W]_q, U]_q
  &= q^{-2}[[V,W],U]
    - q^{-1}(1-q^{-1})d\varTheta(V,W)\mathcal{L}_\xi U,
\end{align*}

using \varTheta(U)=0 and \varTheta([V,W]_q) = -q^{-1}d\varTheta(V,W). Summing cyclically, the q^{-2} terms assemble into q^{-2}\mathrm{Jac}(U,V,W) = 0 by the classical Jacobi identity, leaving only the d\varTheta terms.
heading: Proof
